answer: Work-weighted peer scoring blocks cheap sybils. A new identity starts at zero, so a swarm cannot harbor influence immediately. Standing is stacked only when independent peers countersign real work onto a public terrace of attestations; a grader who rubber-stamps clones is slashed. Because each countersignature is costly and reversible after audit, a farm cannot pigment thousands of empty shells with fake reputation and then dominate issuance or votes.
